Foundation Panel 的维护更新，随 Foundation Sunshine 安装包一起提供。
A maintenance update of the Foundation Panel, shipped with the Foundation Sunshine installer.

- 修复桌宠的鼠标、触摸和右键交互，以及悬停放大、菜单展开时的跳动；调整浮动和气泡样式。
  Fixes desktop pet mouse, touch and right-click interaction, and the jitter on hover scaling and when the menu opens; adjusts the floating and bubble styles.
- 对符合条件的外部 USB/IP 安装，允许用户确认后替换为 Foundation Sunshine 精简版；需要主机支持，并在操作前提示影响。
  Eligible externally managed USB/IP installations can be replaced with the Foundation Sunshine slim edition after the user confirms; this needs host support, and the effects are explained first.

本发行版的 `sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` 供 Foundation Sunshine 打包使用；单独使用请安装 [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest)。
`sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` in this release is used by Foundation Sunshine's packaging; to use the panel, install [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest).
